ios.desc:
You meet the person. Then you book.

Every pet sitter and dog walker on Petme has a real social profile: their posts, their home, their own pets, the way they care for animals every day. By the time you book, you already know who's opening the door for your pet.

Every booking includes
- Access to the Petme Protection Plan: up to $20,000 in vet support
- 24/7 support from real humans, never bots
- No platform fees: you pay the sitter's rate, nothing on top
- Cashback after every completed booking
- Photo and video updates while you're away

Care for every pet
- Dog walking, boarding, house sitting, doggy daycare, and drop-in visits
- Cat sitters too: drop-in visits are made for cats and independent pets
- Every sitter is ID-verified and background-checked
- Message sitters first, follow their feeds, and read reviews from pet parents like you

How it works
1. Sign up free in 30 seconds, no card required
2. Browse sitters near you and explore their profiles
3. Message them and follow their day-to-day on their feed
4. Book and pay securely, then earn cashback after every completed stay
5. Follow your pet's day through updates on your sitter's feed

Why pet parents stay
Trust starts before the booking: you see the person, not just a rating. The price you see is the price you pay. And every time you book, Petme gives some of it back.

For pet sitters
Offer walking, boarding, house sitting, daycare, or drop-in visits. Your profile feed shows pet parents who you really are. Post actively and get discovered locally. Keep up to 90% of what you earn.

Questions? contact@petme.social

show_hn.title: Show HN: Petme – a social platform born from rescuing a kitten

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

Three years ago, I found a tiny kitten in a trash can in Sofia, Bulgaria. I took him home, named him Lindoro Incapaz, and he became my coding companion during the creation of Petme.

Like many pet owners, I was frustrated with existing social platforms. And creating separate pet profiles always seemed odd – pets are family, not side projects. So I did what any reasonable developer would do - I locked myself at home for a year and built Petme!

It’s been a solo dev journey, learning UX/UI design along the way (built with Flutter!), and pouring my savings into it.  But seeing the community grow and people genuinely connect over their pets makes it all worthwhile.

Petme isn't just another social app, I've reimagined how pets exist online:

- Integrated profiles where your pet isn't a separate account, but part of your family
- "Petme Talks" to share those ridiculous conversations you have with your pets
- Pet relatives feature to add your family members to the pet profiles
- Music therapy for pets (yes, really)

Would love to hear your thoughts! Was I crazy to build this? Do pet-focused social platforms make sense to you?

Curious what the HN community thinks!

Links:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zerosgroup.petme&pli=1
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/petme-social-with-your-pet/id1663635642
